options.name: B reconstruida
options.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity complete desktop concept of the Spanish Movie Inbox Home, wide 16:10 image, designed as a usable interface rather than a photograph of a room. This is a conceptual design proposal, not a screenshot of working software. Include at lower margin very small caption "PROPUESTA VISUAL · CONTENIDO DE MUESTRA".
Input images: 1 is the previously liked B visual concept: reference for the content and quality of physical integration, not mandatory topology. 2 is the existing VHS spine asset: reference for worn black cardboard, narrow upright proportions and cream title ink. 3 is the existing category plaque: reference for brass lettering plate style; significantly reduce its gritty surface noise.
Keep Movie Inbox's late 1980s video library identity, semi-illustrated digital painting with deliberate graphic forms and shallow credible depth. Palette near-black petroleum/navy painted material, warm restrained antique brass, cyan legible screen ink and magenta selected-row accent. Extremely subtle material grain, no glossy photorealism. Oswald 400-like regular condensed upright capitals for metal plates, Barlow Condensed-like upright semibold film spine titles, IBM Plex Mono-like legible data. No font hunt or new logo. Brand text "MOVIE INBOX" with incumbent slanted pink-white lettering, "COLECCIÓN" and "MENÚ +" at top right.
Content/order required in all proposals: compact header; upper section with a vertical framed poster on left, centered "HOY" nameplate and two amber lamps (no carousel dots), and a populated six-row playlist on right. Rows: American Hustle, The Hunt, The Expendables 3, In Time, The Grand Budapest Hotel, Kill Chain. Poster can reuse the Jagten art visible in reference 1 as illustrative reference. Retain the upper selected-item strip below that playlist with two usable controls "Ver más" and "Editar mi ficha", a small cover, selected title, shallow cyan signal line, and availability/personal-state text. That strip belongs INSIDE the playlist housing with its screen edge occluded behind the same lip. Then "VIDEOTECA · Tu archivo por categoría", plus discreet lateral navigation arrows. Full-width dense continuous VHS shelf, 15–18 closely packed tall spines, realistic narrow individual widths, titles ascending bottom to top in cream, year and tiny VHS signature at foot. Category plates read "DISPONIBLE ESTA NOCHE", "TU ARCHIVO PIDE MEMORIA", "UNA RUTA POR CINE". Use spine titles from reference or City of Angels, Let Me In, Amores perros, Antichrist, Millennium Actress, Lost Highway, Back to the Future III, 12 Years a Slave, The Mummy, Chappie, X-Men, Come and See. Plates occupy and are screwed INTO the upper crossbeam, never below it in empty space. Spines stand on visible inner shelf floor with physical contact shadows and no gap beneath. Shelf fills about 38% of screen height. At bottom show COMPLETE lower console: actions at left, title/year and synopsis, two film stills, credits and summarized state at right. Use existing labels and "Sin dato" where details unavailable, no invented capabilities or stats. The selected title may be "CITY OF ANGELS (1998)"; do not invent film credits. Lower display is inset BEHIND the common housing bezel, with a cast shadow from the upper lip. All controls stay large enough to read, all elements share lighting direction and coherent border thickness. No boxed cyan overlay floating on top of texture.
Show whole functional Home at once, approximately header 7%, upper program 32%, category rail 7%, tapes 35%, console 16%, remaining structural edges. Avoid empty black fields. Right shelf rails must visibly CONTINUE THROUGH the right image edge: no terminal right post, end cap, gradient fade hiding an end, or blank gap. Left edge and all module joins must be legible. No red annotations. No sci-fi cockpit gauges, cables, arbitrary buttons, neon room or brick, no extra functions. Typography clean rather than gibberish.
SPECIFIC OPTION A — REBUILT B, INTEGRAL LEFT CASTING. Preserve the original B's warm crafted quality but rebuild its actual joints. A narrow 50px-equivalent service upright at far left is physically cast together with the POSTER OUTER FRAME; they share contiguous material, rounded inside corners and a single seam, with NO dark gutter between upright and poster. Upper and lower shelf beams terminate into this upright via visible mortise/flange joints at exact same heights. The poster's lower frame lands directly on the category crossbeam. The full content housing above connects to the same upright. Keep three short vent groups and the approved small inscriptions "ARCHIVO / PELÍCULAS / MEMORIA" and "REBOBINAR / EXPLORAR / CONSERVAR" on the left, integrated into this narrow casting. Reinforce joins at three structural heights with small same-scale brass fasteners; no detached full-height decorative strip. Background is a gently painted dark field continuous with the outer cabinet finish. Scuffs mostly at corners, subdued broad panels; preserve enough tactile soft bevel, occlusion, paper and patina to match the VHS. Do not flatten into thin CSS lines. Make this a beautiful convincing fabrication of the liked B, much calmer in surface texture than reference, with every UI area cut into its chassis.

Design the Home as a wide 1980s professional archive console of folded painted metal and dark bakelite, semi-illustrated, with a substantial shared horizontal faceplate and shallow machined stepped bevels. A slim LEFT RETURN edge connects the top fascia to the shelf and bottom fascia; maximum 18px-equivalent width. Put a short horizontal ventilation bank under the poster and integrate the approved small "ARCHIVO / PELÍCULAS / MEMORIA" serigraphy into that horizontal faceplate. The poster and playlist fit two cavities milled into ONE continuous upper deck. This upper deck directly meets the shelf category beam without black gaps; three category nameplates are flush countersunk inserts IN that beam. Emphasize the wide horizontal shelf lip and lower control deck, connected by identical panel joints and darker inset glass. Broad surfaces satin blue-black with gently worn edges, no ornate brass rails or loud grain. Warm thin brass internal bevels, cyan/magenta functional ink only. Background is exactly the same deep painted color at periphery so the console seems to emerge from the page. Visually different from option A: broad calm horizontal architecture, no monumental upright, dense tapes retain material realism but match softer noise. Complete lower console, right shelf continues beyond the screenshot.

Drastically different attachment strategy while preserving all Home functions and their order: the entire viewport is one designed deep blue-black semi-illustrated painted-laminate surface with NO freestanding box placed on it, NO peripheral bounding rectangle, NO independent vertical spine. The poster/playlist and long VHS shelf are two wide recessed apertures IN the page surface itself. Shallow side reveals, thicker lintel and an ochre-brass inner lip create architectural depth, with front-on orthographic geometry. Brand and navigation are printed/installed directly on the continuous surface above the upper aperture, not in a floating header card. The poster remains vertical in its left part of the upper aperture; the playlist and selected strip are nested to its right with consistent inset shadow. Main shelf cavity cuts all the way out the right edge, with a top fascia that is the SAME painted material and texture as the surrounding page. Category plaques are readable cream/gold condensed typographic inserts flush within that fascia, small fixing slots but not raised shiny plaques. The VHS have a soft illustrated cardboard finish, cream edge abrasion, less microtexture than reference. Lower action keys, two stills and credits sit in a continuous recess underneath the shelf floor, all matched to this same wall. Short horizontal ventilation slots appear in the lower left of the common surface, with subtle approved serigraphy beside them. Show graphic flat surface areas balanced with compelling tangible depth INSIDE the apertures, NOT flat gradient rails or glowing outline boxes. Fewer visible screws than A/B, no painted room, photographic wall, masonry, timber planks, sci-fi spaceship. Background and housing are one material by construction. Maintain amber/cream, cyan data and pink selection accents. Ensure shallow recess shading is visible rather than crushing scene to black.
